title: Small Crate

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to transport items without the worry of items falling out

body:
"Crates can be used to store loose items and move them over long distances without accidentally spilling them, this variant can hold a total of 4x4. Anchoring the crate will anchor everything inside of the crate automatically."

Description

The Small Crate costs $640 and can be found near The Lighthouse (Previously at Jer's Junkyard). It has an internal volume of 4x4 studs. When used, it'll allow you to carry items across the map without the worry of dropping items. It's one of the smallest crates in the game, second only to the Mini Crate sold at The Oak Depot.
